1. RUN git fetch origin main
   IF the fetch fails because there is no `origin`: run `git merge-base main HEAD` in action 2 instead.
   IF the fetch fails any other way: run action 2 unchanged on the `origin/main` already held.
2. RUN git merge-base origin/main HEAD
3. RUN git rev-parse HEAD
4. RUN git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR <BASE>..HEAD -- ':/specs/plans/completed/'
   IF it prints a path: it is a plan branch. Dispatch the explainer subagent with `Plan branch: yes`, ask no question, report `Explainer (<N> words): <path>`, then show the Step 4 menu.
   IF it prints nothing: go to action 5.
5. ASK This branch adds no plan. Do you want an explainer of it before the menu?
   IF yes: run `date +%Y-%m-%d`, `printf '%s\n' "$HOME"` and `git branch --show-current` (each as its own call) to build the output path. Then dispatch the subagent with `Plan branch: no`, report `Explainer (<N> words): <path>`, and show the Step 4 menu.
   IF no: go to Step 4 and show the menu.
